selector.rationale: Positive lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin IgM, and anti-phosphatidylserine IgM support antiphospholipid syndrome, while respiratory syncytial virus infection is noted but less directly linked to the patient's severe symptoms and lab findings

rejected.label: Infectious mononucleosis
rejected.why: Epstein-Barr virus DNA PCR was positive but symptoms and lab findings more closely align with antiphospholipid syndrome

rejected.label: Vasculitis
rejected.why: Punch biopsy revealed thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy without significant neutrophils or leukocytoclasia, more consistent with antiphospholipid syndrome

rejected.label: Thrombotic vasculopathy
rejected.why: While present, thrombotic vasculopathy is a feature of antiphospholipid syndrome, making it a less specific diagnosis
